Extract canonical URL from <link rel='canonical'> tag

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_metadata\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Page</title><link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://example.com/canonical-page\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
